meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取解析流式细胞术标准数据文件并支持生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要处理流式细胞术实验的 FCS 数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写 FCS 流式细胞术文件(2.0–3.1):把事件数据提取成 NumPy 数组,读取元数据、通道信息,导出 CSV,也能新建 FCS 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要解析 FCS 文件、提取事件数据、导出为 CSV 等操作时触发;补偿、门控和 FlowJo 工作区则建议改用 FlowKit。

say.text: 读一下 experiment.fcs,告诉我版本、事件数和通道名
say.note: 返回文件版本、事件数、通道与元数据

say.text: 把这个 FCS 的事件数据导出成 CSV
say.note: 事件转为 DataFrame 后写出 CSV

say.text: 用这份数组和通道名新建一个 FCS 文件
say.note: 导出为 FCS 3.1 单精度浮点文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can read and write FCS 2.0–3.1 flow cytometry files: extract events as NumPy arrays, read metadata and channel info, export to CSV, and create new FCS files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to parse an FCS file, extract event data, or export to CSV, etc.; for compensation, gating, or FlowJo workspaces it points to FlowKit.

say_en.text: Read experiment.fcs and tell me the version, event count, and channel names
say_en.note: Returns version, event count, channels, metadata

say_en.text: Export the events in this FCS file to CSV
say_en.note: Events become a DataFrame written to CSV

say_en.text: Create a new FCS file from this array and channel names
